title: Few-shot Controllable Style Transfer for Low-Resource Multilingual Settings

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation of the model's ability to perform gender neutralization (rewriting gender-specific text into gender-neutral equivalents) using few-shot style transfer.

Evaluation of the model's ability to control stylistic attributes (e.g., formality and code-mixing) across multiple low-resource languages using automatic metrics (transfer accuracy, semantic similarity) and human evaluation, framed as a method to mitigate stylistic biases in text generation.
